text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert fired: HIGH error rate (5xx) on /v1/completions in us-central (threshold: 1.5% -> 6.8%) — PD:INC-74321. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/completions/errors
oncall_sam: acked oncall here, joining. will gather what changed in last 30m
maria_sre: i'm looking at autoscaler and LB metrics now. can someone check recent deploys?
kai_prodeng: pushed a routing config tweak 12m ago to prefer the new small-batch pool for short requests (rollout 3/5). could be correlated.
lina_support: we've got 4 customer tickets in the last 10m mentioning "502" and retries. escalating to customer notifications if impact persists.
maria_sre: logs from the gateway show a surge of 502s with this trace id prefix: trace-1a2b. sample: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/completions \n-H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"prompt":"a","max_tokens":10}'\nHTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream_error: connection reset"}
```
oncall_sam: interesting — autoscaler shows nodes flapping around the same time as the rollout start. maybe the new pool isn't warming caches and causing backpressure.
maria_sre: good call. i'll try toggling routing back to stable pool for a subset of traffic. can we pause the rollout?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for config routing/short-request-pool paused by oncall_sam at 1892103620 — job #deploy-9023 stopped. :white_check_mark:
kai_prodeng: thanks. i'm ready to reroute. maria, what command do you need run?
maria_sre: applying a quick patch to the envoy configmap to set weight of small-batch-pool -> 0 for the completions route, will shift to stable-pool. command: ```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap routing-config -p '{"data":{"completions_weights":"stable=100,small-batch=0"}}'
```
lina_support: i'll hold off customer notifications for 10m while we watch. updating PD incident description with known customers.
maria_sre: patch applied at 1892103725. verifying...
incident-bot: Deploybot: configmap update applied. rolling restart of gateway-proxy-5 pods kicked off.
oncall_sam: checking error rate panels — p95 error rate dropping?
maria_sre: initial 2-min window looks promising: 5xx went from 6.8% -> 2.1% in 3 mins. see: https://grafana.redwood/prod/completions/errors?from=-15m
pagerduty: PD note: Escalated to SRE lead if not resolved in 15m — currently within window.
kai_prodeng: curious if small-batch pool had a degraded NVMe or driver issue — i'll open a node-level ticket to infra.
lina_support: customers D and E acknowledged as impacted, I'm drafting an interim status: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors for completions; mitigation in progress." will send if we don't stabilize.
maria_sre: also seeing increased connection-reset logs on the small-batch hosts, adding to infra ticket.
oncall_sam: are there any retry loops from clients causing fanout? ingress logs show some clients spamming retries at 2xx intervals. not the root cause but amplifying.
maria_sre: i'll add a short-term rate-limit tweak on the gateway for high-retry users: ```
# apply rate limit rule for 10m
kubectl -n prod apply -f gateway-rate-limit-quickfix.yaml
```
incident-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/5xx-spike — suggested mitigations: reroute, pause rollout, scale pool.
maria_sre: after reroute + rate-limit, 5xx is down to 0.9% now over 5m window. keeping watch for 20m.
oncall_sam: thanks team. Lina, hold the customer msg pending stable -> if anything changes, ping me and we'll trigger external comms.
lina_support: noted. I'll prepare the template and keep it ready.
kai_prodeng: infra ticket opened: INFRA-1890 (possible disk io on small-batch pool). tagging infra on that.
maria_sre: marking PD incident as "mitigated" for now, will wait 20m and then close if stable.
incident-bot: PD update: INC-74321 set to mitigated by oncall_sam at 1892103920 — awaiting closure. :white_check_mark:
oncall_sam: leaving a short postmortem pointer: investigate canary warmup & routing-weight defaults, consider health checks before shifting traffic.
maria_sre: agreed. will raise a follow-up ticket to tighten canary weight ramp and add proactive cache warmers.
lina_support: prepping a customer note draft — will sync with Sam before sending.
incident-bot: final update: 5xx error rate remained <=1% for 25m; PD incident INC-74321 resolved by oncall_sam at 1892104056. :tada:
all: thanks everyone.
